votes.motion: to approve the minutes from September 21, 2015
votes.quote: minutes from september 21, 2015 were read and accepted
on a motion by steve schaff to adjourn and seconded by lorraine mendoza, the vote was unanimous to adjourn
minutes from may 25, 2016 were read and accepted.

votes.motion: Place the sum of $35,000.00 onto a warrant article for the special town meeting
votes.quote: commissioner schaff made a motion to place the sum of $35,000.00 onto a warrant artice for the special town meeting. commissioner mendoza seconded the motion and wih no further discussion, the motion passed unanimously.

votes.motion: Withdraw the bid for road work from Powell Construction for $1,650.00
votes.quote: commissioner schaff made a motion to withdraw the bid for road work from powell construction for $1,650.00. commissioner mendoza 2nded the motion and upon no further discussion, the vote to withdraw the bid was unanimous.

votes.motion: Withdraw the bid of $4,800.00 from M+M Tree Service
votes.quote: commissioner schaff making a motion to withdraw the bid of $4,800.00 from m+m tree service. commissioner mendoza seconded and after no further discussion, a unanimous vote to withdraw the bid was completed.

votes.motion: Withdraw the bid from Affordable Tree Service in the amount of $1,650.00
votes.quote: commissioner mendoza made a motion to withdraw the did from affordable tree service in the amount of $1,650.00 and seconded by commissioner schaff. with no further discussion, the vote passed unanimously

votes.motion: Withdraw the bid of $15,890.00 from T Bennet Tree Service
votes.quote: commissioner schaff moved to withdraw the bid of $15,890.00 from t bennet tree service. commissioner mendoza seconded and with no further discussion the vote passed unanimously.
a motion was made by commissioner schaff to adjourn and seconded by commissioner mendoza and with no further discussion the vote was unanimous to adjourn.

votes.motion: Accept minutes from the June 15, 2016 meeting
votes.quote: minutes of the june 15, 2016 were read and accepted
lance may nominating steve schaff for chairman. lorraine mendoza offered a second to this motion and with-out further discussion a unanimous vote was taken electing steve to be the new chairman.

votes.motion: Elect Lorraine Mendoza as Vice Chairman
votes.quote: a motion was made by lance may and seconded by steve schaff nominating lorraine mendoza - as vice chairman and with-out further discussion, a unanimous vote was taken to elect lorraine mendoza to be the new vice chairman.

steve schaff made a motion to nominate lance may -as the clerk and lorraine mendoza seconded his motion and with-out further discussion, a unanimous vote was taken to elect lance may -as the new clerk.
a motion was made by lorraine mendoza to close the meeting and seconded by lance may to adjourn. the vote was unanimous.

votes.motion: Award the landscaping bid to Lakeview Landscaping to replace shrubs destroyed by vandalism.
votes.quote: on a motion from vice chair mendoza and a second from chair schaff, and upon no further discussion, a unanimous vote was made to award the bid to the lowest bidder, lakeview landscaping.

chair schaff asked for a motion to close the meeting with commissioner may making that motion and commissioner mendoza offering a second. there was no further discussion on the motion and it passed unanimously to adjourn the meeting.

votes.motion: Accept the minutes from the September 16, 2016 meeting
votes.quote: a motion was made by commissioner mendoza and seconded by commissioner may to accept the minutes and upon no further discussion the minutes were accepted

votes.motion: Accept two changes to cemetery rules: allowing the Chairman and Superintendent of Cemeteries to open and close the cemeteries due to seasonal weather, and making the center gate a one-way entrance from Holman Street
votes.quote: commissioner mendoza made a motion to accept this two changes, chair schaff seconded her motion and upon no further discussion the motion carried to allow for the chairman and supt of cemetery's to open and close them due to seasonal weather related issues and to make the center gate a one-way entrance.

chair schaff asked for a motion to close the meeting and commissioner mendoza made that motion with commissioner may offering a second. there was no further discussion on the motion and it passed unanimously to adjourn the meeting.
